notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a delete save button to the error screen
[*]The "WAKE UP" text that appears when using the alarm no longer blocks mouse input
[*]Fixed a bug where you could lock Dave outside the school during the exit section of the game

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update is way overdue but I finally fixed all of the random bugs that make the game basically unplayable. For anyone curious it was a bug with the restart button and it wouldn't properly load your save for some reason so unpredictable things were able to happen to your save file. 

That's the only real change in this update, its to fix that exit glitch. If anyone is still having that error screen delete your save file and restart the game, it'll make a new one for you. 

Happy Gaming, From Dave and Friends

notes.title: 1.1.0 - The Localization Update
notes.content:
For the past 8 months, I have been working on localizing the (almost) full game and also adding some minor stuff.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Game is fully localized, from UI text to menu and others
[*] There are now subtitles in the game
[*] 5 new language options have been introduced (German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, French)
You can find who contributed to these in the Credits
[*] Gotta Sleep has been completely revamped, including his sprites and game mechanics
[*] PlayRobot's sprites have been updated
[*] New item: Somebody's Calculator
Right click a chalkboard while holding it to instantly answer the question correctly. Unpredictable consequences may arrive upon attempting to answer the impossible question using this item.
[*] After Hours has been buffed (this has also changed the ambient lighting color of Cell Mode)
[*] Dave's speed in Teleportation Madness has been decreased slightly
[*] In Teleportation Madness, Dave now teleports closer to you if you get too far away
[*] Fixed bug with the Sunglasses where if you had an FOV that was different from the default it would be offset
[*] Fixed Algebra Antics bug. Do not try to cheat. Haha
[*] Most audio in the game is preloaded, which should minimize the amount of lag that occurs when any sort of audio playing occurs
[*] In Cell Mode, Crypt and Creep will attempt to avoid Crawl in order to prevent them from getting stuck on each other
[*] Crawl now periodically teleports to your nearest location
[/list]

I believe that's everything. I've changed a lot so I've likely missed some stuff but that should give you the scope of what to expect. Dave says: have fun!

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
Ever wanted to play Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered on the go? Me neither. But now you can!

With the patches included in 1.0.2, the game is now fully playable on the Steam Deck. Now you can take Dave (and all of his friends) wherever you'd like! Maybe to the beach, or on a hike, or even a prison cell, perchance. The possibilities are endless!

Make sure you greet Cell on the way out. Or you could do it on the Steam Deck, whichever you prefer.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum allowed mouse sensitivity (the original value adjustment in 1.0.1 was too low for controllers)
[*] You can no longer play Modified mode without selecting any modifiers, you now must select at least one
[*] Fixed a bug where the in-game cursor is behind the control mapper 
[*] Fixed a bug where any answer that included all numbers from 0-9 was always correct in Algebra Antics
[*] Made tip text and instructions text in Modified mode screen bigger, should be easier to read on Steam Deck
[*] The game now pauses when the Steam Overlay is opened mid-game
[*] The teleporter item now temporarily makes you invincible
[*] Fixed bug where eating a cupcake before an event that involves acquiring infinite stamina results in resetting it
[*] You can now click normal doors again to close them
[*] Characters can now see you through double doors, windows, and also normal doors while they are opened (except for Crypt, Crawl, and Creep)
[*] Spike no longer starts in the detention room
[*] Fixed bug where Alien Hall Monitor wouldn't send Spike to detention after calling him to your location
[*] Fixed bug where Spike wouldn't play the audio he's supposed to play when you approach him
[*] Fixed bug where tip text gets cut off on some resolutions
[/list]

Dave says: [i]have fun![/i]

notes.title: DFAC 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I feel like with this update, Cell Mode should be significantly less frustrating. I've been reading feedback through reviews and comments and I feel like I've made the gamemode much more balanced than it was before, especially with the pre-boss section.

Updates: 

[list]
[*] Fixed Prepared For Class achievement
[*] Made Cell mode preboss and first phase much easier
[*] Fixed Danger Meter not being anchored to the bottom right of the screen
[*] Other gamemodes show in Cellmode title screen
[*] Fixed framerate affecting camera speed (you might have to mess with your camera sensitivity)
[*] Crawl no longer ends your game if they aren't chasing you
[*] Creep is slower and visits fewer locations, resulting in a shorter lifetime
[*] Crypt also visits fewer locations
[*] Teleporters have been removed from the Cell mode item pool
[*] Coins no longer spawn in Cell mode
[*] Soda and NRG Bars now spawn in Cell mode
[*] Text color changes in Cell mode depending on the general lighting
[*] You now lose points for missing Null Pie shots in Cell mode
[*] Fixed billboards updating late when looking behind you
[*] In the finale mode for Cell mode, you now have infinite stamina
[*] You can no longer run in the first and second phases of Cell mode
[*] Cell's speed has been decreased in the first phase of Cell mode
[/list]
